_doc: Constructed fist, 80 px, ROUND 2 (round 1: fist_80.json). Critique round 1: 'at 80 the grip hand drops to 2-3 skin pixels, so it does not read at all; force a 3x3 minimum skin fist with a dark outline instead of trusting the downscale'. A 3 x 3 skin block (r lit ridge S1, t thumb S1/S2, b S2, B/k/d S3 shade) inside an OL ring (O = OL always), the wrist 'w' one cell out; same frame and labels as fist_144_r2.json.
